# tee

Copy standard input to files and standard output through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/tee -p output.txt

moonx cli/tee -p -a output.txt < extra.txt
```

Write each input byte to stdout and every file operand. Files are truncated unless -a selects append mode.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--append` | Append instead of truncating files. |
| `--output-error VALUE` | Modes: warn, warn-nopipe, exit, exit-nopipe; bare flag selects warn-nopipe. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-p` | Modes: warn, warn-nopipe, exit, exit-nopipe; bare flag selects warn-nopipe. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Use -p or --output-error with warn, warn-nopipe, exit or exit-nopipe. Default broken-pipe handling reports an unsupported capability with status 2 instead of raising SIGPIPE.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
